notes: No qal is attested for this root; hiphil ("make glorious; magnify") is the more active sense and is treated as the primary/citation stem rather than niphal's passive "be glorious" -- DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE set to hiphil in both UI templates.
Thinly attested: only one form each for niphal and hiphil.

Trimmed "magnify" -- re-examining the citation (Isa.42.21, "he will magnify the law, and make it honourable"), "magnify" actually translates a DIFFERENT Hebrew verb in the same verse (H1431 גדל), not this root; only "make it honourable/glorious" corresponds to H142 itself. This is a citation-misattribution catch from the tightened compound-gloss audit, not just a redundant synonym.
